# US Wealth Management Capability Catalog Crosswalk

<!-- Generated by `npm run catalog` from catalog/catalog.json. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

All **400** catalog resources are assigned to a `wealth-skills` pack with a coverage tier. **108** are backed by engine code; the rest are workflow guidance or cited references. Assignment is not implementation: the tier says exactly how much of each resource this library does, and nothing here replaces a named commercial product.

## Tiers

| Tier | Meaning | Items |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | A library function implements the core calculation or check for this item. | 14 |
| `partial-engine` | A library function covers a stated part; the rest is guidance. | 82 |
| `payload-builder` | Builds request payloads locally; nothing is connected or submitted. | 12 |
| `guidance` | SKILL.md workflow guidance with no engine code. | 29 |
| `standard-reference` | A specification or rule the pack cites; not implemented. | 65 |
| `integration-reference` | An open-source project named as an optional integration. | 100 |
| `research-reference` | A paper cited as methodology or evidence. | 98 |
